description:
First BenchBox change for moving the oracle reviewer (_project/scripts/oracle_reviewers/, oracle_gate.py, oracle_review_check.py and the matcher) into BenchBox-dev/theseus. Docs only; no code moves.

Deliver one ADR under _project/decisions/ and an inventory the later items consume. The ADR records: purpose and the in-BenchBox-package alternative with the owner decision from theseus-decision-separate-repo-20261102; ownership split; identity narrowing (App login, attesters and gated branch become consumer configuration; verdict marker, status contexts, artifact names and finding IDs stay stable); installation trust chain (consumer trusted commit -> reviewed lock -> verified bytes -> isolated install, no latest, no ambient install, cache keyed by hash); promotion review rules; recovery (owner-only, docs/agent/emergency-merge.md); rejected alternatives (wheel-extraction CI stage, BenchBox matcher plus second parser, granting the gate Actions read, a new App-authored promotion record).

Guardrails: worktree only (make worktree-create; make agent-write-preflight). No code, workflow or setting change. Do not rename persisted identifiers. Comment policy applies. Cite or explicitly supersede each prior oracle decision record (REVIEW-PLAN-RECON-001).
